name.zh: 仓敷藏人对莎拉·布拉德莉莉

periods.summary: Sara defeats Kurando in C-block second round after revealing that her Phantasmal Caricature can create weapons, armies and even copies of Ikki using Ittou Shura.
periods.cause: Kurando seeks to win one more match to earn a rematch with Ikki, while Sara treats him as an obstacle delaying her artistic obsession with Ikki.
periods.process: Kurando opens with his newly evolved two-sword Orochimaru. Sara uses Color Magic for water movement, fire, guiding lines and steel-hardening, then escalates to Phantasmal Caricature, drawing guns, missiles and an undead army. Kurando survives with Godspeed Reflex, his flexible Device and Ayatsuji-style Ten'i Muhou. Sara finally draws an Ikki copy using Ittou Shura. Kurando is initially overwhelmed, then erupts in anger when real Ikki cheers him on and destroys one copy with a sixteen-hit two-sword finisher. Sara simply creates additional Ikki copies, which impale him.
periods.outcome: Kurando is defeated and carried away; Sara advances without receiving a scratch.
periods.aftermath: Commentary identifies Sara's true ability as A-class or equivalent and warns that she may be able to use virtually any Blazer's abilities through drawings. Ikki realizes he may have to face her later the same day after Byakuya.
periods.significance: Reveals Sara as one of the tournament's most dangerous hidden A-class threats and ends Kurando's hoped-for rematch with Ikki.
